name: NCTE classroom transcripts
summary: 1,660 anonymized transcripts of U.S. 4th and 5th grade math lessons, with turn-level discourse annotations on a subset.

license.note: MIT covers the repository's code. The transcripts have no open license: their terms of use limit them to research and forbid sharing them.

access_note: Each user agrees to the terms of use in a form; the data folder is then shared with them.
cite: Demszky, D., & Hill, H. (2023). The NCTE Transcripts: A Dataset of Elementary Math Classroom Transcripts. BEA 2023. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2023.bea-1.44

fits.how: Its discourse annotations could check a detector that marks moments in classroom or tutoring talk, for research.
